title: Human gold set — v1.0
description: A human-curated set of interaction edges for one pilot cluster, used to measure what the pipeline PROPOSES against what a human says is there. plan.md §5.2's independence argument is the whole reason it exists: 'R2 proves coverage relative to accepted I; it does not prove I complete. Since Stage 3 generates both I and O, independent candidate sources are mandatory.' A gold set is the human end of that independence, so it sits on the REVIEWED side of this codebase's line (specs/_gold_sets/<cluster>.json, with a review block, promoted through the same checkpoint as any other reviewed artifact) rather than the machine-observation side (docs/callsite-schema.json, docs/achieved-assurance-schema.json): it is a judgement about what edges exist, and a judgement with no author is not evidence of anything. The one thing it must never be is derived from the interaction set it audits -- recall against a gold set copied out of I is vacuously 1.0. That cannot be proven mechanically, so every edge declares HOW the curator found it, and `derived_from` has no value naming the I set; a curator who worked from I has to write something false rather than merely omit something. Never a claim of completeness either: humans miss edges, so `curation_scope.completeness_claim` is a lower bound, exactly as a syntactic extractor's is (chainlink #24).

cluster.description: Must equal the filename stem exactly (G1b), the same discipline every other artifact here follows. Names the pilot cluster this gold set covers -- the issue's own unit is 'at least one pilot cluster per test track'.

track.description: plan.md §11's two test tracks: mode-r (greenfield) and mode-p (a foreign-language port validated by differential testing, chainlink #5). Checked against the project descriptor's own `mode` -- a gold set claiming the track this workspace is not running measures nothing that is here.

curation_scope.description: What the curator actually looked at. Precision and recall are only meaningful relative to this: counting a proposed edge as a false positive because the curator never examined its caller would measure the curator's time, not the pipeline's quality.

examined_concepts.description: The concepts whose outgoing edges the curator examined exhaustively. Measurement is restricted to edges whose CALLER is one of these.

method.description: How the curation was done. Deliberately excludes reading the interaction set: see this schema's own description.

completeness_claim.description: A single value, and a deliberately weak one. A gold set says 'at least these edges exist', never 'exactly these'. An omission count computed against it is therefore itself a lower bound, and scripts/measure_gold_set.py says so in every report rather than letting the number read as a ceiling.

edges.description: Non-empty: a gold set with no edges cannot measure precision, recall or omission, and a measurement that cannot be computed must never read as a good score (chainlink #48's discipline applied to this gate's own input).

derived_from.description: How the curator found THIS edge. The enum has no value for 'read it in the interaction set' on purpose -- a gold set derived from the artifact it audits makes recall vacuous, and the schema refuses to provide the vocabulary for it. Every value here must also appear in curation_scope.method (G1b): an edge found by a method the curator never claimed to use is unexplained.

rationale.description: Why this edge is real. A gold set is the human end of an independence argument; an edge with no stated reason cannot be argued with.

expected_eligibility.description: Optional. What the curator expects plan.md §5.2's computed eligibility to come out as. Never used to overrule the computation (G1b recomputes eligibility from edge_class and rejects disagreement); it is recorded so a systematic difference between human expectation and the computed table is visible rather than invisible.

role.description: Identical to docs/interaction-schema.json's and docs/callsite-schema.json's own role definition -- the three vocabularies must not drift, since measurement compares edges across all three.

review.description: Attached by review_checkpoint.approve() after a human signs off, never authored by a proposing model. A gold set a model wrote for itself audits nothing.
